name: Chiyo Tsukimura
want: keep Tsukimura-ya open for one more generation
secret: The inn is behind on its bank loan; unless something changes by next spring, it will have to be sold.
voice: Old Ibaraki dialect, short scolding sentences, a hand on the shoulder after.
description: Has run the family inn by Fukuroda Falls for fifty years. Calls the dorm every few days to check that her grandchild is eating.
appearance: Small and straight-backed, a dark kimono for work, reading glasses, a voice that fills a room.

agenda.goal: keep the inn afloat without worrying the children
steps: meets the bank man in Daigo and asks for more time
sells her best kimono in Mito and says it was going to waste
writes to an old regular in Tokyo about investing in the inn
